decisions.reason: The PDF-first confirmation sequence remains unchanged, and its reference to other agreed formats already accommodates the revised drawing-format package.
The candidate already has a same-message update establishing STEP and native SolidWorks part and assembly files; replacing DXF with SLDDRW in the drawing package does not alter the 3D model package.
The drawing file-format change does not alter the required colors of drawing views.
The deliverable-format change does not alter the requirement to retain the bushing and sliding-mandrel holes.
The revised drawing formats do not change the bushing's location, retention, fit, motion, or guidance arrangement.
The file-format package does not affect assembly-aligned drawing numbering.
Changing the delivered drawing formats does not change the requirement to comply with ČSN/EN drawing standards.
The client-supplied drawing setup reference remains valid independently of the final drawing file formats.
The drawing-format revision does not alter the locking-thread geometry or main-bushing space.
The 120-degree lug-hole spacing remains unchanged by the deliverable-format decision.
The revised drawing file package does not change the main-shaft material, fabrication sequence, or machining operations.
The file-format change does not affect the requirement to omit the main-shaft keyway.
